b: Eight months after the Miskatonic Massacre, Doctors Herbert West (Jeffrey Combs) and Dan Cain (Bruce Abbott) are back, working as volunteer medics in a Peruvian civil war. But death is only the beginning: Once home, West resumes his experiments, this time with a twisted new goal—to create life from spare parts and bring Dan’s late fiancée back as the ultimate re-animated creation. Brian Yuzna’s splatter-soaked cult sequel, drenched in dark humor and grand guignol horror, pushes the boundaries of body horror with jaw-dropping practical effects from Screaming Mad George and KNB EFX Group, and returns in a new director-approved 4K restoration.
Bride of Re-Animator arrives in stores on 4K UHD Blu-ray on December 15.
